citation.title: Development of KSTAR ECE imaging system for measurement of temperature fluctuations and edge density fluctuations
citation.authors: G. S. Yun, W. Lee, M. J. Choi, J. B. Kim, H. K. Park, C. W. Domier, B. Tobias, T. Liang, X. Kong, N. C. Luhmann Jr., A. J. H. Donné

topic: KSTAR ECEI hardware design and the interpretation of optically thin edge ECE as a mixture of Te and ne fluctuations
own_question: How can an ECEI system be built for KSTAR to give 2D imaging of HFS and LFS fluctuations, and when can edge ECE signals reflect density rather than Te?
actual_method_and_evidence: This is an instrument design paper; it presents no plasma results. It describes a dual 24x8 array with 384 channels in total, Cooke-triplet zoom optics, BWO local oscillators and a video bandwidth of up to 400 kHz. The edge-density argument is a theoretical relation from optical thickness (Eqs. 4-6) that follows Peters et al. The authors write that density interpretation is envisioned and is possible only under favorable conditions.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: KSTAR ECEI measures electron-cyclotron emission. Its signals are normally used as normalized fluctuation measurements rather than absolute calibrated Te.
claim_checks.original_pdf_locator: p.2 Introduction; p.4 Sec. III after Eq. 3
claim_checks.qualification: This describes ECEI practice at the time, attributed to the difficulty of absolute calibration. It supports our use of raw ECEI voltages, not calibrated Te.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: In the optically thin edge, ECE fluctuations can contain both Te and ne contributions, so edge ECEI signals need not reflect Te alone.
claim_checks.qualification: This is a theoretical relation with assumed wall reflection near 0.8 and small tau. It was not validated in the paper. Equations were extracted imperfectly.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: ECEI is an electron diagnostic. The paper contains no CES, impurity Ti or nowcasting content. The 400 kHz figure is a hardware bandwidth, not the cadence of our 10 ms snapshots.
validation_if_relevant: No validation; this is a design description before KSTAR operation.
forbidden_inferences: ECEI measures ion or impurity temperature
density was recovered experimentally from edge ECEI
the 2022 KSTAR ECEI configuration matches this 2010 design
the paper establishes a physical mechanism linking ECEI to CES Ti
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Include as the instrument reference for the ECEI inputs. It also gives background on why edge ECEI voltages are mixed Te/ne proxies rather than calibrated Te.
